brand.purpose: The landing wordmark only. Centered under 640px; fluid at 12.4vw so it fills a 350px column.

display.purpose: The single page h1 on each app screen. The one Fraunces setting in the app.

headline.purpose: Landing message line under the wordmark.

title-sm.purpose: Section heads, help and post card titles.

label.purpose: StatusLabel pills; tab captions use 10.5px of the same style.

shadows.name: inset-only
shadows.purpose: Grouped-list panes; they sit in the field.

shadows.name: glass-float
shadows.purpose: Top bar, tab bar, rail, Home help pane.

motion.name: ease-out
motion.purpose: Default exponential ease-out for entrances and the tab indicator.

motion.name: ambient-drift
motion.purpose: body::before ambient blobs; off under reduced motion.

motion.name: pane-in
motion.purpose: Pane entrance; off under reduced motion.

material.glass: backdrop-filter: blur(24px) saturate(1.6); 1px glass border; inset top highlight; 1px specular rim via ::before (135° highlight gradient masked to the border)
material.ambient: body::before, position: fixed, inset: -20%, five radial gradients from ambient-teal / ambient-sky, filter: blur(32px); light mixes 100/100/70 %, dark 45/40/22 %

components.name: Primary Button
components.description: Filled teal action, 14px radius, 44px tall; the only pill buttons are compact chips and icon buttons.
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { display:inline-flex; align-items:center; justify-content:center; gap:8px; min-height:44px; padding:8px 16px; border:0; border-radius:14px; background:var(--color-primary, #0a6560); color:#fff; font:600 14px/1 Manrope, system-ui, sans-serif; box-shadow: inset 0 1px 0 0 rgba(255,255,255,0.28); cursor:pointer; transition: background-color 150ms cubic-bezier(0.23,1,0.32,1), transform 150ms cubic-bezier(0.23,1,0.32,1); } .ds-btn-primary:hover { background:var(--color-primary-ink, #084f4b); } .ds-btn-primary:active { transform:scale(0.97); } .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { outline:none; box-shadow: inset 0 1px 0 0 rgba(255,255,255,0.28), 0 0 0 3px rgba(10,101,96,0.5); }

components.name: Glass Button
components.description: Outline variant on glass-strong with the specular rim.
components.css: .ds-btn-glass { position:relative; display:inline-flex; align-items:center; justify-content:center; min-height:44px; padding:8px 16px; border:1px solid var(--color-glass-border, rgba(16,36,58,0.09)); border-radius:14px; background:var(--color-glass-strong, rgba(255,255,255,0.64)); -webkit-backdrop-filter: blur(28px) saturate(1.8); backdrop-filter: blur(28px) saturate(1.8); color:var(--color-foreground, #10243a); font:600 14px/1 Manrope, system-ui, sans-serif; box-shadow: inset 0 1px 0 0 var(--color-glass-highlight, rgba(255,255,255,0.85)), 0 1px 1px rgba(16,36,58,0.04), 0 10px 30px -14px rgba(16,36,58,0.22); cursor:pointer; transition: background-color 150ms cubic-bezier(0.23,1,0.32,1), transform 150ms cubic-bezier(0.23,1,0.32,1); } .ds-btn-glass:hover { background: rgba(255,255,255,0.8); } .ds-btn-glass:active { transform:scale(0.97); } .ds-btn-glass:focus-visible { outline:none; box-shadow: 0 0 0 3px rgba(10,101,96,0.5); }

components.name: Status Label
components.description: 24px pill carrying a readable status word; sits beside a title or in the meta line, never above a heading.
components.css: .ds-label { display:inline-flex; align-items:center; min-height:24px; padding:0 8px; border-radius:9999px; background: rgba(16,36,58,0.08); color:var(--color-foreground, #10243a); font:600 11px/1 Manrope, system-ui, sans-serif; letter-spacing:0.01em; } .ds-label-official { background: rgba(10,101,96,0.12); color: var(--color-primary-ink, #084f4b); }

components.name: Glass Pane
components.description: Resting translucent pane with blur, hairline, inset highlight, soft offset shadow, and specular rim.
components.html:
Need something nearby?

Official updates, local talk, and opt-in help.
components.css: .ds-pane { position:relative; padding:16px; border:1px solid var(--color-glass-border, rgba(16,36,58,0.09)); border-radius:22px; background:var(--color-glass, rgba(255,255,255,0.46)); -webkit-backdrop-filter: blur(24px) saturate(1.6); backdrop-filter: blur(24px) saturate(1.6); box-shadow: inset 0 1px 0 0 var(--color-glass-highlight, rgba(255,255,255,0.85)), 0 1px 1px rgba(16,36,58,0.04), 0 10px 30px -14px rgba(16,36,58,0.22); color: var(--color-foreground, #10243a); } .ds-pane::before { content:''; position:absolute; inset:0; border-radius:inherit; padding:1px; background: linear-gradient(135deg, rgba(255,255,255,0.85), rgba(255,255,255,0.13) 45%, transparent); -webkit-mask: linear-gradient(#000 0 0) content-box, linear-gradient(#000 0 0); -webkit-mask-composite: xor; mask: linear-gradient(#000 0 0) content-box, linear-gradient(#000 0 0); mask-composite: exclude; pointer-events:none; } .ds-pane-title { margin:0; font:600 22px/1.2 Manrope, system-ui, sans-serif; letter-spacing:-0.02em; } .ds-pane-body { margin:6px 0 0; font:400 14px/1.5 Manrope, system-ui, sans-serif; color: var(--color-muted-foreground, #4d5d6b); }

components.name: Grouped Rows
components.description: Settings-style list inside a pane: hairline dividers, 56px rows, trailing chevron, no offset shadow.
components.html: Build an emergency planPreparedBCUnderstand power outagesBC Hydro
components.css: .ds-rows { overflow:hidden; border:1px solid var(--color-glass-border, rgba(16,36,58,0.09)); border-radius:22px; background:var(--color-glass, rgba(255,255,255,0.46)); -webkit-backdrop-filter: blur(24px) saturate(1.6); backdrop-filter: blur(24px) saturate(1.6); box-shadow: inset 0 1px 0 0 var(--color-glass-highlight, rgba(255,255,255,0.85)); } .ds-row { display:flex; align-items:center; gap:12px; min-height:56px; padding:12px 16px; color: var(--color-foreground, #10243a); text-decoration:none; transition: background-color 150ms; } .ds-row + .ds-row { border-top:1px solid var(--color-border, rgba(16,36,58,0.1)); } .ds-row:hover, .ds-row:focus-visible { background: rgba(16,36,58,0.05); outline:none; } .ds-row-text { flex:1; min-width:0; display:grid; } .ds-row-title { font:600 16px/1.3 Manrope, system-ui, sans-serif; white-space:nowrap; overflow:hidden; text-overflow:ellipsis; } .ds-row-meta { font:500 14px/1.4 Manrope, system-ui, sans-serif; color: var(--color-muted-foreground, #4d5d6b); } .ds-row svg { flex:none; color: var(--color-muted-foreground, #4d5d6b); }

components.name: Input
components.description: 12px field on 70% card fill; 16px text; 3px ring on focus.
components.css: .ds-input { width:100%; min-height:44px; padding:0 14px; border:1px solid var(--color-input, rgba(16,36,58,0.16)); border-radius:12px; background: rgba(255,255,255,0.7); color: var(--color-foreground, #10243a); font:400 16px/1.4 Manrope, system-ui, sans-serif; transition: box-shadow 150ms, border-color 150ms; } .ds-input::placeholder { color: var(--color-muted-foreground, #4d5d6b); } .ds-input:focus-visible { outline:none; border-color: var(--color-primary, #0a6560); box-shadow: 0 0 0 3px rgba(10,101,96,0.35); }

components.name: Glass Tab Bar
components.description: Floating glass pill with a sliding indicator; five 44px targets inside 64px.
components.html: HomeCommunitiesActivity
components.css: .ds-tabs { position:relative; display:grid; grid-template-columns: repeat(3, 1fr); height:64px; padding:6px; border:1px solid var(--color-glass-border, rgba(16,36,58,0.09)); border-radius:9999px; background: var(--color-glass-strong, rgba(255,255,255,0.64)); -webkit-backdrop-filter: blur(28px) saturate(1.8); backdrop-filter: blur(28px) saturate(1.8); box-shadow: inset 0 1px 0 0 var(--color-glass-highlight, rgba(255,255,255,0.85)), 0 2px 4px rgba(16,36,58,0.06), 0 18px 44px -18px rgba(16,36,58,0.32); } .ds-tabs-indicator { position:absolute; top:6px; bottom:6px; left:6px; width: calc((100% - 12px) / 3); border-radius:9999px; background: rgba(16,36,58,0.08); box-shadow: inset 0 1px 0 0 var(--color-glass-highlight, rgba(255,255,255,0.85)); transition: transform 300ms cubic-bezier(0.23,1,0.32,1); } .ds-tab { position:relative; z-index:1; display:flex; flex-direction:column; align-items:center; justify-content:center; gap:2px; min-height:44px; border-radius:9999px; color: var(--color-muted-foreground, #4d5d6b); font:600 10.5px/1 Manrope, system-ui, sans-serif; text-decoration:none; transition: color 200ms cubic-bezier(0.77,0,0.175,1); } .ds-tab-active { color: var(--color-foreground, #10243a); } .ds-tab-active svg { color: var(--color-primary, #0a6560); } .ds-tab:focus-visible { outline:none; box-shadow: 0 0 0 3px rgba(10,101,96,0.5); }

narrative.overview:
NeighbourGrid is a quiet place to check on your block when the power is uncertain. The whole product sits on one near-white (or, following the device, near-black) field with two slow teal and sky ambient blobs drifting behind it. Every piece of interface is a translucent glass pane that lets that field through: blurred, saturated, rimmed with a specular hairline, and softly lifted. The field is atmosphere; the glass is structure; the copy is the content. Nothing else competes.

Density is low and the text is cut hard: one short line per section, details behind a tap, disclaimers folded into a single footnote per screen. Fraunces appears exactly once per screen, on the brand or the one display headline; everything else is Manrope. Teal is the only accent and does only one job, action. Coral exists for the Community Help Beacon and nowhere else. The old navy full-bleed hero, divider-only lists, and amber badge stacks are the anti-reference this world replaced.
keyCharacteristics: One ambient field (fixed, blurred, drifting) under every surface; only `html` paints the ground.
Glass panes at three depths: grouped lists sit in the field, panes rest on it, controls float over it.
Settings-style grouped rows with hairline dividers and chevrons, never card grids.
Pill geometry for floating controls (top bar, tab bar, chips); 14px controls and 22px panes for everything else.
Light and dark follow `prefers-color-scheme`; dark is neutral near-black with the accents as glow.
Required labels (Official / Community-reported / DEMO) and the beacon's 911 sentence are never designed away.

rules.name: The One Accent Rule
rules.body: Teal is the only colour that means "act". Coral means "beacon" and nothing else. Status is carried by a text label, never by colour alone.

rules.name: The Field Shows Through Rule
rules.body: No element between `html` and a glass pane may paint an opaque background. If a pane reads as a white card, the glass alpha is too high or something underneath is opaque.

rules.name: The One Serif Rule
rules.body: Beyond the wordmark in the top bar, Fraunces appears exactly once per screen: the brand on the landing, the `h1` in the app. Pane titles, card titles, avatars, and section heads are Manrope.

rules.name: The No Eyebrow Rule
rules.body: Nothing sits above a heading. Kind and status labels live beside the title or in the meta line beneath it.

rules.name: The Three Tiers Rule
rules.body: Lists sit in the field, panes rest on it, controls float over it. A surface that needs a fourth level is a modal, and modals are rare.

dos: Do paint the ground only on `html` and keep `body`, `#root`, and layout wrappers transparent.
Do put every status word in a `StatusLabel` and every disclaimer in the screen's single `Footnote`.
Do use grouped rows (`Pane` + `ng-row-divide`) for lists; same-size card grids are not this world.
Do keep the beacon sentence verbatim: "Community volunteers may not respond. For immediate danger, call 911. This is not an emergency service."
Do gate all motion behind `prefers-reduced-motion: no-preference` and keep defaults fully visible.
donts: Don't place a label, kicker, or chip above a heading.
Don't set more than one Fraunces element per screen besides the wordmark.
Don't use a pill radius on a primary or full-width action; pills are for floating controls and chips.
Don't tint the dark ground toward navy; it is neutral near-black and the colour comes from the ambient glow.
Don't convey status by colour alone, nest panes, or invent live outage or response-time claims.
